source.citation: Johnson, J. W., Oelkers, E. H., Helgeson, H. C. (1992). SUPCRT92: A software package for calculating the standard molal thermodynamic properties of minerals, gases, aqueous species, and reactions from 1 to 5000 bar and 0 to 1000 C. Computers & Geosciences 18(7), 899-947.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF from the publisher), the paragraph following Eqs. (5)-(7), p. 901, read on its text layer
transcription.note: The properties of liquid water at its triple point to which the steam-table convention of the equations of state of water (zero entropy and energy there) is referred, after Helgeson and Kirkham (1974a). The calorie is the thermochemical calorie, 4.184 J by definition, which the units write out.

water_triple_point_temperature.description: Temperature of the triple point of water, T_tr.

water_triple_point_entropy.description: Molal entropy of liquid water at its triple point, S_tr, in cal/(mol K).

water_triple_point_enthalpy.description: Apparent molal enthalpy of formation of liquid water at its triple point, H_tr, in cal/mol.

water_triple_point_gibbs_energy.description: Apparent molal Gibbs energy of formation of liquid water at its triple point, G_tr, in cal/mol.
